test_cases.title: A read-only web service operation returns its response
acs: DERIVED: Zero-argument read-only operations (Get, Fetch, List, Find, Is, Has, Count) return a SOAP response - 1 operation(s) (data/depth.json)
assumptions: The web services run at http://localhost:1935 and need no sign-in locally.
Data table: the Examples table of the matching scenario outline lists every row; each row is one execution.
Only zero-argument operations whose names start with Get, Fetch, List, Find, Is, Has or Count are called, so nothing is written.
The response content is not checked beyond the response element.

steps.action: Send a SOAP POST for the operation in the row to the service in the row.

steps.expected: The body is a SOAP envelope.

open_questions: DERIVED criteria come from read-only surveys of the running apps; confirm the labels and buttons are the intended behaviour.
